claim: The KV cache indexer decomposes into six named components: kvcache.Indexer (orchestrator), kvevents.Pool (ZMQ event ingestion), kvblock.Index (in-memory two-level LRU block-hash-to-pod map), tokenization.PrefixStore (LRU tokenized-prefix cache), kvblock.TokenProcessor (token-to-block-key hashing matching vLLM), and kvblock.Scorer (longest-consecutive-prefix scoring).
quoted_support: kvblock.Index | Core data store mapping block hashes to pods | In-memory two-level LRU cache for sub-millisecond lookups

claim: This Oct 2025 article describes the ZMQ topic format as 'kv@pod-id@model', which conflicts with the current (2026) llm-d GitHub guide's format of 'kv@$(POD_IP):$(POD_PORT)@<model>' keyed by literal IP:port rather than a pod identifier.
stance_target: claim that KV-event topic is keyed by Kubernetes pod-id/name
scope_conditions: article dated Oct 7 2025; superseded by 2026 llm-d main-branch guide -- flagged discrepancy, not to be treated as current
quoted_support: Message reception: Events parsed by topic format: kv@pod-id@model

claim: EPP endpoint discovery for KV-cache-aware routing in this deployment path is driven by a Kubernetes Service label (llm-d.ai/inferenceServing: "true"), which the EPP uses to automatically discover and manage decode-service endpoints via label selector.
stance_target: discovery of ZMQ endpoints via Kubernetes-native mechanisms (pod/service watch) vs static config
scope_conditions: official llm-d community Helm chart deployment, Oct 2025
quoted_support: For automatic discovery, the decode service must have the following label: llm-d.ai/inferenceServing: "true"

claim: In a production Tekton-pipeline test, llm-d's KV cache aware routing achieved an 87.4% cache hit rate (4,176 of 4,776 queries) with 99.92% of traffic concentrated on a single warm pod, and cut TTFT from 2,850ms (cold) to 340ms (warm cache hit), an 88% reduction.
stance_target: real-world performance benefit of KV-cache-aware routing
scope_conditions: IBM/Red Hat OpenShift test deployment, Oct 2025
quoted_support: Cache hit rate: 87.4% (improved from previous 86%)... Warm cache hit | 2,850 ms TTFT (worst case) | 340 ms TTFT | 88% faster
